title: Resource group sprawl detection
description: Identifies resource group proliferation that increases management overhead and indicates organizational disorder.
example_prompt: "Analyze all resource groups across subscriptions. Flag: (1) empty RGs with 0 resources, (2) RGs with only 1 resource (consolidation candidate), (3) RGs with names suggesting temporary/test purpose in production, (4) RGs without required tags. Show RG name, resource count, total cost, and creation date."
